svg.title: Blueprint 7 — Semantic Web, Isolated SPARQL Runner & AI-Fetchable Share Feeds
svg.desc: Three-column security boundary and protocol flow diagram showing 5 semantic web consumers, Cloudflare/negotiation/RDF/AI-share pipelines, and the hardened HMAC-signed isolated sparql-runner container.
svg.text: Blueprint 7 — Semantic Web, Isolated SPARQL Runner & AI-Fetchable Share Feeds
iqoqo v1.1.2 • Content Negotiation, Query-Free AI JSON-LD Pages, Streaming Exports & Hardened SPARQL Perimeter
Gemini App, ChatGPT Web, Claude Web
Zero custom Accept headers or ? queries
Data Sovereignty — full WEMI library dump
• SELECT / ASK → SPARQL JSON / XML / CSV
• AI Crawl Control unblocked so Google/AI bots read /robots.txt cleanly
• Browser (Accept: text/html) → HTTP 303 Redirect to Next.js UI page
• Open Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * for browser & sandbox AI agents
• Short context aliases: t, a, f, l, c, y, g
• Ready-to-use Gem skills in docs/gems/* (HiFi, Reading, Games, Cinema)
• Chunked batch serialization via Flask stream_with_context()
• Response Header: X-Accel-Buffering: no (Nginx unbuffered stream)
• Handles 10,000+ item collections without memory pressure
Canonical dereferenceable subject URIs across all RDF graphs
Namespaces: frbr: • frbrer: • schema: • dc: • iqoqo:
Movie, Game, Product, MusicEvent, Periodical, PublicationIssue
• Audio Matrix Runout + FRBRoo F18 Serials + OpenCollections owl:sameAs
• Builds caller-scoped RDF graph snapshots for SPARQL Runner →
• Fail-closed: verifies HMAC, expiry, replay nonce
• cgroup ceilings: 1.0 CPU • 512 MB RAM • 64 PIDs
• Query size cap: 10 KB | Snapshot cap: 10 MB
• Isolated forked process per query execution
Retained over Apache Fuseki (lean 60MB idle RAM)
